units.source_text: 这是个阴天，白头鸟鸣啭不已。

en.t: It was an overcast day, and the white-headed bulbuls kept singing without pause.

units.source_text: 来到走廊，看见泉畔开了两朵杜鹃花，也结了蓓蕾。

en.t: When he came to the corridor, he saw two azalea blossoms blooming by the spring, with buds forming as well.
A yellow wagtail flew close to the corridor.

units.source_text: 远处传来了电动机抽温泉水的声音。

en.t: From far away came the sound of an electric motor pumping hot spring water.
